definitions.explanation: The southern part of Europe, typically including countries such as Italy, Spain, Portugal, and Greece. Used in geography, travel, cuisine, and cultural discussions.

examples.japanese: {南欧|なんおう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{南欧|なんおう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦オリーブ→オリーブ：10808_oriibu⟧⟦オイル→オイル：10731_oiru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Southern European cuisine uses a lot of olive oil.

examples.japanese: {南欧|なんおう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地中海性気候|ちちゅうかいせいきこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{比較的|ひかくてき}→比較的：06172_hikakuteki⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: Southern Europe has a Mediterranean climate and is relatively warm even in winter.

notes:
Composed of {南|なん} (south) and {欧|おう} (Europe, short for ⟦{欧州|おうしゅう}→欧州：13186_oushuu⟧). Part of a set of geographic terms using the same pattern.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{北欧|ほくおう}→北欧：10139_hokuou⟧: Northern Europe (Scandinavia)
- {西欧|せいおう}: Western Europe
- {東欧|とうおう}: Eastern Europe
- {中欧|ちゅうおう}: Central Europe
- ⟦{欧州|おうしゅう}→欧州：13186_oushuu⟧: Europe (formal)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南欧|なんおう}{風|ふう}: Southern European style
- {南欧|なんおう}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: Southern European cuisine
- {南欧|なんおう}⟦{諸国|しょこく}→諸国：15992_shokoku⟧: the countries of Southern Europe
- {南欧|なんおう}⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: trip to Southern Europe

USAGE:
Used as a modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or in compound nouns. Common in travel writing, food culture, and architecture discussions. {南欧|なんおう}{風|ふう} (Southern European style) is frequently used to describe Mediterranean-inspired home design and interior decoration in Japan.
